title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the total cross section sigma(E) as E approaches 0.

title: Wave Function Form
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive the form of the s-wave function R(r) from the given differential equation.

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply the boundary conditions correctly to find the relationship between the constants alpha and beta.

title: Energy Limit Behavior
description: Important Criteria: The student should analyze the behavior of the cross section as E approaches 0, including the implications for k and alpha_1.

title: Trigonometric Relationships
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include the derivation of the relationship between k and alpha_1 using trigonometric identities.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that the units of the final expression for sigma(E) are consistent with cross section units.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common mistakes such as incorrect application of boundary conditions or sign errors in the wave function.
